description: Fix repeated WebSocket drops behind Tailscale Funnel: the server idle-watchdog closed quiet-but-healthy sockets after 75s (client pings never reset it), and proxies close silent routes. Client now sends a ping heartbeat every 25s and the server counts client pings as activity.
features: Client WS heartbeat every 25s keeps the funnel route and server watchdog alive; dead sockets are detected and reconnected.
Server ping op now counts as activity, so quiet sockets are no longer killed after 75s.
Version synced to 0.17.4 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
